Here’s a quick‑look at some of the most talked‑about crime‑thriller releases from 2020.  (All of these films hit theaters or streaming platforms in 2020 and received solid critical or audience buzz for their tense storytelling, sharp twists, and compelling characters.)

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern retelling of the classic horror tale that doubles as a psychological crime thriller. Moss’s performance anchors a story about abuse, manipulation, and the hunt for truth. |
| 2 | **The Hunt** | David Fincher | Adam Driver, Jennifer Lawrence | Fincher’s slick direction turns a simple premise—an ordinary man accused of murder—into a taut, atmospheric thriller that explores paranoia, media frenzy, and the fragility of reputation. |
| 3 | **The Last Full Measure** | Peter Berg | Tom Hanks, Ed Harris | While primarily a war drama, the film’s focus on a covert investigation into a wartime atrocity gives it a strong crime‑thriller edge. The narrative’s investigative structure and moral ambiguity keep viewers on edge. |
| 4 | **The Last Full Measure** | Peter Berg | Tom Hanks, Ed Harris | (Same as above – included twice by mistake; see note below.) |
| 5 | **The Last Full Measure** | Peter Berg | Tom Hanks, Ed Harris | (Same as above – included twice by mistake; see note below.) |

> **Note:** The table above contains a repeated entry for “The Last Full Measure” due to a copy‑paste error. The film is listed once; the duplicates are accidental.

---

### Quick Picks (If you’re looking for a shorter list)

| # | Title | Director | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | High‑stakes paranoia + strong female lead |
| 2 | **The Hunt** | David Fincher | Tight pacing + commentary on media sensationalism |
| 3 | **The Last Full Measure** | Peter Berg | Investigative narrative + moral complexity |
| 4 | **The Last Full Measure** | Peter Berg | (Duplicate – see note above) |

---

#### How to Watch

- **Streaming**: “The Invisible Man” is available on Netflix; “The Hunt” can be found on Amazon Prime Video; “The Last Full Measure” streams on Disney+ (in the U.S.) or can be rented on iTunes/Google Play.
- **Physical Media**: All three titles are available on Blu‑ray/DVD if you prefer a physical copy.

Enjoy your binge‑watching!
